newEntry.name: Slide & Poise
newEntry.desc: Snip twenty runners, glue a calibrated mast and suspend an asymmetric beam, printed load and sliding cord-hung poise for a steelyard moment ritual. Measured sheet/socket reference, actual-mesh balance calculation, local PNG/JPEG/SVG relief and verified ASCII/binary STL plinth marks; connected-card, five-part STL and assembly ZIP. Thread and adhesive required; not a calibrated scale.
